## What changed or decided
- **`scripts/shiki_github.py`** — added `configure_workflow_permissions(repo, *, can_approve_pull_requests=True, default_permissions="read", provider_config=None)`. It PUTs `repos/{repo}/actions/permissions/workflow` with `{default_workflow_permissions, can_approve_pull_request_reviews}` via the exact `gh api ... -X PUT --input -` pattern as `protect_branch`; `info()` on success, **`warn()` (not raise)** on failure with remediation text. Matches the doctor's `doctor.github.workflow_permissions` expectation (`read` + `true`).
- **`scripts/shiki_bootstrap.py`** — imported and called it in `cmd_bootstrap_github` and `cmd_init`, immediately after `protect_branch` inside the `if args.protect:` block; added `workflow-permissions:` dry-run lines (configure line under protect, skip note under `--no-protect`).
- **`tests/test_workflow_permissions_payload.py`** — new unittest (mirrors `test_branch_protection_payload.py`) asserting the PUT path, default `read`+`can-approve=true` payload, override honoring, and warn-not-raise on gh failure.
- **`scripts/test_shiki_init.sh` / `scripts/test_shiki_start.sh`** — gh stubs now accept the `actions/permissions/workflow` PUT (routed to a separate payload file); init asserts the dry-run line, the `--no-protect` skip note, the execute-path PUT, and the payload; start adds a protect-enabled run asserting the PUT + payload through `cmd_start → cmd_init`.
- **`docs/adr/0013-bootstrap-grants-actions-approve-pull-requests.md`** — records the `can_approve_pull_request_reviews=true` bootstrap default and the CCA-Review-Bridge / solo-maintainer security tradeoff (relates to G-0012 / closed #106), the `read` least-privilege default, and warn-not-fail.
